section.catchline: Definitions -- Commission authorized to adjust taxing entity's certified rate for clerical error -- Requirements -- Amount of adjustment.
section.subsection:
For purposes of this section:
"Clerical error" means the following in an assessment roll: an omission; an error; or a defect in form. "Year" means the period beginning on January 1 and ending on December 31 during which there is a clerical error on the taxing entity's assessment roll.

subsection.subsection: The adjustment under Subsection (2) is an amount equal to the lesser of: the difference between the taxing entity's budgeted collections for the year and the taxing entity's actual collections for the year; or the amount of the clerical error.

The commission shall make an adjustment under Subsection (2) no later than 90 days after the day on which the county treasurer made the final annual settlement with the taxing entity under Section 59-2-1365.
